title: Existence of the concrete Godement cosimplicial operators
statement: There exist a cosimplicial object with Godement iterates, unit-insertion cofaces and multiplication codegeneracies.

proof.text: Construct the free-quiver action on the concrete iterates and operators. Its lifted path functor preserves all simplex relations by the concrete coordinate calculation and induction. Descend through the relation quotient using CategoryTheory.Quotient.lift.

Prove fullness of the canonical presentation functor by strong induction on source length plus target length. A noninjective map factors off a sigma; a nonsurjective map factors off a delta. An injective and surjective map has equal source and target lengths and is the identity. Faithfulness supplies unique preimages. Define the desired functor by applying the quotient functor to these preimages. The preimage identity and composition lemmas prove its functor laws.

The constructed objects are definitionally T^(n+1)(F). For each delta or sigma, preimage_map identifies its unique preimage with the corresponding generator in the quotient. Quotient.lift_map_functor_map and Paths.lift_toPath identify the result with the concrete operator. Choose reflexive object equalities and supply these two operator equations.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCup_godement_cosimplicial_exists (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (A : CosimplicialObject X.Modules)
      (h : ∀ n : ℕ, A.obj ⦋n⦌ = moduleCup_godementIterate X F (n + 1)),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 2)),
        eqToHom (h n) ≫ moduleCup_godementInsert X F (n + 1) i =
          A.map (SimplexCategory.δ i) ≫ eqToHom (h (n + 1))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)),
        eqToHom (h (n + 1)) ≫ moduleCup_godementCollapse X F n i =
          A.map (SimplexCategory.σ i) ≫ eqToHom (h n))
